headline: Hydration tracker overhaul
intro: Tune your stream hydration overlay from one place — preview included.

features.title: Tools → Hydration panel
features.body: A dedicated dashboard with a live preview of your hydration browser source while you adjust gauge style, colors, sounds, and channel point rewards.

features.title: Five gauge styles & effects
features.body: Pick circular, bottle, minimal, and more. Sparkle and confetti effects render inside the water fill, with optional sounds and go-live reset behavior.
